tagline: Only spacecraft to orbit two extraterrestrial worlds — Vesta then Ceres via ion propulsion
description: NASA Discovery-class mission powered by three NSTAR xenon ion thrusters that produced the 11 km/s of total delta-v needed to enter orbit around Vesta, escape, cruise three years, and enter orbit around Ceres. Mapped both bodies in unprecedented detail — Vesta's southern Rheasilvia basin, Ceres' bright Cerealia Facula spots, ammoniated phyllosilicates, and cryovolcanism at Ahuna Mons. Mission ended 2018 when reaction-control hydrazine was exhausted; the spacecraft remains in a stable orbit around Ceres.
best_known_for: Only spacecraft to orbit two extraterrestrial worlds — Vesta (2011-2012), Ceres (2015-2018)
